messages:
Ivy: Quick heads-up: PR 5340 preview shows the console "embed gallery" rendering plain code blocks in Netlify. Local `mkdocs serve` looks fine. Also found several SDK snippets still using `traceid` (no underscore) or the old `trace_id` key.
Ben: Hmm. Could be our sanitizer change removing `data-` attributes that the embed renderer depends on. Which file is failing?
Ivy: docs/console/tracing.md on the gallery example. Netlify logs show `AttributeRemoved: data-widget-id`. Link: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/33444/logs
Kai: I can reproduce. Looks like the sanitizer whitelist dropped `data-widget-*`. I'll add an mkdocs extension patch to allow `data-widget-id` and `data-src`.
Ivy: Also the gallery image ordering got scrambled because a migration script replaced hyphens with underscores in filenames. Netlify sorts by filename so order changed. Can we add a check?
Ben: I'll add a lightweight action to docs-lint to: 1) verify that every referenced image in docs exists; 2) warn if filenames contain underscores. That should catch both missing assets and unintended renames.
doc-bot: Reminder: PR 5340 failed link-check and image-checks in CI. See run: https://github.com/redwoodinc/redwood-docs/actions/runs/123456789
Kai: For snippets, I propose standardizing examples to `trace_id_hex` everywhere and adding a short migration note at top of tracing.md with before/after. Tiny diff we can include: ```diff
- await client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ await client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0xabcd' })
```
Ivy: Good. Please also grep for `traceid` (no underscore) and `trace_id\b` across docs; we should avoid partial matches. I can push a follow-up PR that updates the caption text for the screenshots to explicit labels (e.g., "p95 latency heatmap") so ordering errors are less confusing.
Ben: Plan: (1) revert any sanitizer bump in the preview branch to unblock authors; (2) Kai pushes allowlist change and tests locally; (3) I add docs-lint GH action to validate image refs and filename style; (4) Ivy opens SDK-snippet cleanups + migration blurb.
infra-bot: Created issue infra#docs-image-lint. CI job `docs-image-check` added to PR workflow.
Ivy: I'll coordinate screenshots upload to `docs/assets/screens/` and keep hyphenated names. Once the lint and allowlist land, re-open preview. Thanks!
